_about: Extra search keys for names children say differently from the data's spelling. Keys are written in hiragana and folded by fold.js at build time. Keep this short: the loose kana tier (small っ, ー and small kana ignored) already covers spelling slips such as えむばっぺ for エムバペ; add an entry only for a genuinely different name. Written 2026-09-11.
